explanation: Use two pointers at the ends of the sorted list. Compare their 64-bit mathematical sum with the target: move the lower pointer after a sum that is too small and the upper pointer after a sum that is too large. Keep lower <= upper so the same position may supply both terms, as the EPI contract permits.
timeComplexity: O(n) time for a random-access sorted list of n elements.
attribution: Original Java implementation independently authored for EPI Practice from its displayed mathematical contract, using 64-bit intermediate arithmetic. No upstream reference implementation adapted. Public EPIJudge interface and test framework retained under the repository LICENSE.
